app_name: AI Movie Translator & Auto Dubbing Studio
changelog_km:
កំណែថ្មី v1.4.0:
- 📦 មុខងារ Batch Mode ទាំង Folder (Natural Sort EP1/EP2/EP10, Start/Pause/Resume/Cancel/Retry, Clear Queue & Log, Resume តាម JSON, Glossary រួម)
- 🎬 កំណត់ទីតាំងបិទបាំងអក្សរចិន & 🎛️ សំឡេង Audio Mix + Preview 12s ដាច់ដោយឡែកក្នុង Batch និង per-episode override
- 💬 គាំទ្រ OpenAI / ChatGPT (រក្សាទុក Key សុវត្ថិភាពក្នុង OS Credential Store, Chunked Audio STT & Batch JSON Translation)
- ⚡ បង្កើនល្បឿនដកស្រង់ OCR (RapidOCR max side 960), បកប្រែ Gemini/Google Batch និង សំឡេង AI Edge-TTS ៥ ដងព្រមគ្នា + តម្រឹមអក្សរចំកណ្ដាលប្រអប់ខ្មៅ/ព្រិល 1:1
changelog_en:
Release v1.4.0:
- 📦 Full-Folder Batch Mode (Natural Sort EP1/EP2/EP10, Start/Pause/Resume/Cancel/Retry, Clear Queue & Log, JSON queue persistence, Shared Glossary)
- 🎬 Batch Original Subtitle Masking & 🎛️ Audio Mix + 12s Preview with per-episode overrides isolated from single-video settings
- 💬 OpenAI / ChatGPT integration (OS Credential Store API key security, silence-aware chunked STT, structured Batch JSON translation)
- ⚡ Major speedups across OCR (RapidOCR max-side 960 + fast seek probe), Gemini Batch JSON & concurrent Google translation, 5x parallel Edge-TTS, and exact 1:1 Khmer subtitle vertical centering
